glutathione-research.title: Glutathione for Skin: Benefits, Studies and How to Use It
glutathione-research.description: Topical 2% glutathione lowered skin pigment by 10.7% in 10 weeks in its one controlled trial, vs 3.1% for placebo. The evidence, graded, and how to use it.
